name: contradiction-mcp
description: Production-quality MCP server for detecting conflicting and inconsistent information across connected sources

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && mkdir -p dist/storage/migrations && cp src/storage/migrations/*.sql dist/storage/migrations/
scripts.seed: tsx -e "import { DatabaseManager } from './src/storage/database.js'; import { seedDemoData } from './src/scripts/seedDemoData.js'; const db = new DatabaseManager('./data/contradiction.db'); db.initialize(); seedDemoData(db); db.close();"
scripts.migrate: tsx -e "import { DatabaseManager } from './src/storage/database.js'; const db = new DatabaseManager('./data/contradiction.db'); db.initialize(); console.log('Migrations executed successfully'); db.close();"
scripts.backup: tsx -e "import { DatabaseManager } from './src/storage/database.js'; import { BackupService } from './src/storage/backupService.js'; const db = new DatabaseManager('./data/contradiction.db'); db.initialize(); const b = new BackupService(db); b.createBackup('./backups').then(p => { console.log('Backup created:', p); db.close(); });"
scripts.restore: tsx -e "import { DatabaseManager } from './src/storage/database.js'; import { BackupService } from './src/storage/backupService.js'; const db = new DatabaseManager('./data/contradiction.db'); const b = new BackupService(db); const latest = process.argv[2]; if (!latest) { console.error('Provide backup file path: npm run restore <path>'); process.exit(1); } b.restoreBackup(latest, './data/contradiction.db'); console.log('Restored successfully');"
scripts.health: tsx -e "import { DatabaseManager } from './src/storage/database.js'; import { HealthService } from './src/services/healthService.js'; import { config } from './src/config/env.js'; const db = new DatabaseManager('./data/contradiction.db'); db.initialize(); const h = new HealthService(db, config); h.getHealth().then(r => { console.log(JSON.stringify(r, null, 2)); db.close(); });"
scripts.live-test: npm run smoke && vitest run tests/protocol/mcpStreamableHttp.test.ts

author: Contradiction MCP Team
